newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER CHILAVERT SCORES ON OPENING WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER CHILAVERT SCORES ON OPENING WEEKEND.

text.p: Velez Sarsfield goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert celebrated the opening day of the new Argentine championship by scoring from a penalty in his team's game with Newell's Old Boys on Sunday.
The Paraguayan international sent his opposite number Cristian Cejas the wrong way in the 23rd minute to score his 12th goal for the club. His tally includes free kicks as well as penalties.
Velez, however, let two points slip when Julio Saldana scored four mintues from time to earn Newell's a 1-1 draw.
Boca Juniors, playing their first competitive game since Hector Vieira took over from Carlos Bilardo as coach, beat Estudiantes 2-1 with striker Diego Latorre scoring the winner in the 57th minute.
Vieira occupies the hottest seat in Argentine club soccer.
Boca, the country's most popular club, have not won a title since 1993 and last week saw Diego Maradona turn down a last ditch invitation to renew his contract with the club.
Racing, another major club desperate for a title, began in disastrous fashion as they crashed 5-0 away to Rosario Central.
The club, now coached by former national team coach Alfio Basile, have not won a domestic title for 31 years.

River Plate, who won this season's Apertura championship, beat Gimnasia-La Plata 2-0 away, despite being without star player Ariel Ortega. The Argentine international began a five-match suspension after being sent off in a pre-season tournament match against Boca.
The championship which started this weekend is known as the Clausura -- closing -- and is the second of two tournaments played in the Argentine season.
